title: Pond Placement + Setup
goal: Choose the final location, level the Manhattan pond and test the setup before planting.

recommendation.summary: Option 2 is the best overall fit for the finished pond design, utilities, maintenance access and jasmine layout. Confirm that it receives enough true direct sun for healthy lotus growth before locking the location.
why: Best fit for the complete Jasmine — Pond — Jasmine composition
Easy water, GFCI and filter access
Good maintenance access and low dog/predator concern
Option 1 remains the backup because its north placement and possible 4–6 hours of sun may be better for lotus
recommendation.decisionGate: Do not lock Option 2 until direct-sun exposure is verified.

items.note: Buy only if the chosen location is not already flat, level and stable.

shoppingList.note: No liner is needed; the Manhattan is the waterproof pond vessel.

completionMemory.title: End of Phase 4
completionMemory.caption: Manhattan pond placed, leveled and leak-tested in its permanent location.
